mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the matrix-enforcement fact lets Alloy invent a Permitted ListAudit attempt by a non-administrator (Nurse), which is exactly the role-op cell the matrix forbids and which FR-017 explicitly disallows.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeastPrivilegeViolation { some a: AccessAttempt | a.outcome = Permitted and a.kind = ListAudit and a.caller.role = Nurse }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the care-team gating fact lets a clinician obtain a Permitted ReadRecord outcome with no matching active care-team-membership row, which is the canonical ownership-based-access violation.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CareTeamGatingViolation { some a: AccessAttempt | a.outcome = Permitted and a.kind = ReadRecord and a.caller.role = Doctor and (no m: CareTeamMembership | m.clinician = a.caller and m.ctmPatient = a.targetPatient and m.status = Active) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the always-on audit fact lets Alloy produce an authenticated, Permitted ReadRecord attempt with no associated AuditEntry, violating audit completeness and the SLA invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditMissing { some a: AccessAttempt | a.authenticated = True and a.kind = ReadRecord and a.outcome = Permitted and (no e: AuditEntry | e.attempt = a) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the clinical-author-only fact lets a ClinicalNote materialise with an administrator author-role snapshot, which the data-model CHECK on author_role and FR-011's append-only constraints rule out.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AdminAuthoredNote { some n: ClinicalNote | n.authorRoleSnap = HospitalAdministrator }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the admin content-blindness fact lets a ListAudit attempt expose clinical content, breaking the administrator-only audit-endpoint invariant and the response-shape constraint.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AdminLeak { some a: AccessAttempt | a.kind = ListAudit and a.exposesClinicalContent = True and a.outcome = Permitted and a.caller.role = HospitalAdministrator }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the byte-equivalent-denial fact lets Alloy build a Denied attempt that still exposes clinical content, which is exactly the information-leak counterexample the assertion targets.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DenialLeak { some a: AccessAttempt | a.outcome = Denied and a.exposesClinicalContent = True }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the per-attempt uniqueness of AuditEntries lets two audit rows point at the same attempt, which is how an UPDATE-equivalent mutation of audit state would manifest structurally.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DuplicateAudit { some disj e1, e2: AuditEntry | e1.attempt = e2.attempt }
